% Requires: amsmath, amssymb
\subsection{Simple $\cD(G)$-modules}
\label{subsec:simples_summary}
We list the $56$ simple $\cD(G)$-modules $M_1,\dots,M_{56}$ stored in \texttt{SimplesMn}, where $G$ is the group \texttt{C2 x A4} of order $24$. For each module we give its dimension, the element $g$ it is attached to (with the centralizer of $g$), its basis, the matrices of the generators $t,x,y,z$ of $G$ (in the order of \texttt{generatorsofgroup}; matrices act on column vectors) and the nonzero matrices $\delta_h$ of $\Bbbk^G$, which are diagonal. Entries are written in terms of $\zeta_k=e^{2\pi i/k}$, with $\zeta=\zeta_3$.

\begin{samepage}\noindent\textbf{\underline{1}}\quad $M(0,\tau_{00})$, $\dim=1$; attached to $g=(0,0)$ (centralizer \texttt{C2 x A4}).\\
Basis: $b_{1}=(0,0)\otimes 1$.\\
$[t]=1$,\quad $[x]=1$,\quad $[y]=1$,\quad $[z]=1$.\\
Nonzero $\delta_h$: $\delta_{(0,0)}=1$.\end{samepage}
\medskip
